sentences.en: On Thursday, three years after his appointment as special counsel,
sentences.zh: 周四，在他被任命为特别检察官三年后，

sentences.en: Jack Smith finally delivered the legal argument against President Trump that he was never allowed to make in court.
sentences.zh: 杰克·史密斯终于提出了针对特朗普总统的法律论点，而这些论点他此前从未被允许在法庭上陈述。

sentences.en: Today, what Smith told Congress and why his message is likely to make him
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将探讨史密斯对国会说了什么，以及为什么他的言论很可能使他成为

sentences.en: Trump's next target for prosecution.
sentences.zh: 特朗普下一个起诉的目标。

sentences.en: It's Friday, January 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月23日，星期五。

sentences.en: Glenn, can you just describe exactly where you are?
sentences.zh: 格伦，你能描述一下你现在具体在哪里吗？

sentences.en: It's somewhere in the Capitol complex.
sentences.zh: 在国会大厦建筑群的某个地方。

sentences.en: Yes, I am in the Byzantine maze of the United States Capitol.
sentences.zh: 是的，我身处美国国会大厦那错综复杂的迷宫之中。

sentences.en: I've just come out of the hearing room where Jack Smith spent approximately four, four and a half hours being grilled by the House Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: 我刚从听证会现场出来，杰克·史密斯在那里接受了众议院司法委员会大约四个到四个半小时的盘问。

sentences.en: Thank you for sticking around after the hearing to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 感谢你在听证会后留下来接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: I want to begin with the context for this hearing, the backstory behind why we're finally hearing from Jack Smith,
sentences.zh: 我想先从这次听证会的背景谈起，也就是为什么我们最终能听到杰克·史密斯的证词，

sentences.en: a special counsel who ended up overseeing these two sprawling criminal investigations into President Trump in between his first and second term.
sentences.zh: 这位特别检察官在特朗普总统第一任期和第二任期之间，负责监督这两项庞大的刑事调查。

sentences.en: And it just seems worth saying, this is a prosecutor on whose shoulders, in a lot of ways, rested the very question of whether Trump could ever be president again,
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，在很多方面，特朗普是否还能再次担任总统的问题，都压在了这位检察官的肩上，

sentences.en: or might he have ended up in prison?
sentences.zh: 或者他是否可能最终入狱？

sentences.en: I mean, he's just so central to the entire story of the Trump era in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在很多方面，他确实是特朗普时代整个故事的核心人物。

sentences.en: Look, for about a year, late 2022 to late 2023,
sentences.zh: 你看，从2022年底到2023年底，大约一年的时间里，

sentences.en: Jack Smith was arguably one of the most important figures in the country.
sentences.zh: 杰克·史密斯可以说是这个国家最重要的人物之一。

sentences.en: And his road to this committee room was a pretty torturous path.
sentences.zh: 而他通往这个委员会会议室的道路相当曲折。

sentences.en: In late 2022, just to refresh people's memories,
sentences.zh: 2022年底，为了帮大家回忆一下，

sentences.en: Merrick Garland, then the Attorney General, is really in a corner.
sentences.zh: 时任司法部长梅里克·加兰确实陷入了困境。

sentences.en: He can't personally investigate all the allegations against Donald Trump because he was appointed by Trump's political adversary, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 他不能亲自调查针对唐纳德·特朗普的所有指控，因为他是被特朗普的政治对手乔·拜登任命的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like a classic conflict of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 就像经典的利益冲突。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So he appoints Jack Smith, who at this point was serving as a war crimes prosecutor in The Hague, to take over the two investigations into Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以他任命了当时正在海牙担任战争罪检察官的杰克·史密斯，来接手针对唐纳德·特朗普的两项调查。

sentences.en: One of which is a little bit more amorphous, but probably more consequential.
sentences.zh: 其中一项稍微模糊一些，但可能后果更严重。

sentences.en: Whether or not Donald Trump sicked the mob on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 即唐纳德·特朗普是否在2021年1月6日煽动暴徒冲击美国

sentences.en: Capitol on January 6th, 2021, and attempted to obstruct the election of Joe Biden as president.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦，并试图阻挠乔·拜登当选总统。

sentences.en: The other one was more simple.
sentences.zh: 另一项则更简单。

sentences.en: So simple, in fact, it's defined by one image.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它简单到可以用一张照片来定义。

sentences.en: This picture of boxes in Donald Trump's bathroom at Mar-a-Lago of classified material.
sentences.zh: 就是那张在海湖庄园唐纳德·特朗普浴室里存放机密文件的箱子的照片。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One is basically, did he conspire to overturn an election?
sentences.zh: 一项基本上是关于他是否密谋推翻选举？

sentences.en: And the other is, did he conspire to hide classified documents that he allegedly knew the government wanted back?
sentences.zh: 而另一项是，他是否密谋隐藏他明知政府想要回的机密文件？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So Jack Smith throws himself into these two cases.
sentences.zh: 所以杰克·史密斯全身心地投入到这两个案件中。

sentences.en: A lot of the evidence had already been collected before he ever walked in the door.
sentences.zh: 在他接手之前，大部分证据就已经收集完毕了。

sentences.en: But he was known as a hard-driving prosecutor, more like a manager.
sentences.zh: 但他以强硬的检察官著称，更像是一位管理者。

sentences.en: Think of him as like a baseball manager who has a very aggressive managing style.
sentences.zh: 你可以把他想象成一位管理风格非常激进的棒球教练。

sentences.en: He kind of takes the players that he inherited, but he moves them forward propulsively because there is a sense that he's got to move fast
sentences.zh: 他接手了现有的球员，但他推动他们快速前进，因为有一种紧迫感，他必须加快速度，

sentences.en: before the political season catches up to him.
sentences.zh: 赶在政治季节追上他之前。

sentences.en: Long story short, he doesn't really make it.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，他并没有真正成功。

sentences.en: He successfully gets two grand jury indictments, but then the investigation's timetable slams into the timetable of the 2024 election.
sentences.zh: 他成功获得了两项大陪审团起诉，但随后调查的时间表与2024年大选的时间表发生了碰撞。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Donald Trump gets elected, and then Smith has to drop both cases because of the DOJ policy against prosecuting a sitting president
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普当选了，史密斯不得不放弃这两个案件，因为司法部有反对起诉在任总统的政策，

sentences.en: because it would interfere with a president's capacity to govern.
sentences.zh: 因为这会干扰总统的执政能力。

sentences.en: So Donald Trump gets sworn in as president, and Jack Smith disappears just about as quickly as he popped onto the scene.
sentences.zh: 所以唐纳德·特朗普宣誓就职总统，而杰克·史密斯就像他出现时一样迅速消失了。

sentences.en: He keeps a low profile.
sentences.zh: 他保持低调。

sentences.en: He knows he's a target of Trump and Trump supporters.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己是特朗普及其支持者的目标。

sentences.en: He doesn't even do anything in terms of his career.
sentences.zh: 他在职业生涯方面甚至什么都没做。

sentences.en: He just kind of stays at home, keeps his head down, tries to avoid the spotlight, doesn't want to give Trump or anybody in Congress any justification for going after him,
sentences.zh: 他只是待在家里，保持低调，尽量避开聚光灯，不想给特朗普或国会中的任何人提供攻击他的理由，

sentences.en: and essentially vanishes.
sentences.zh: 基本上就销声匿迹了。

sentences.en: I think a few of us imagined that he would pretty much remain disappeared under a Republican-controlled government because they would rather the entire chapter he represented
sentences.zh: 我想我们中很少有人会想到，在共和党控制的政府下，他会一直保持消失状态，因为他们宁愿他所代表的整个篇章

sentences.en: just be buried in the history books.
sentences.zh: 就这样被埋没在历史书中。

sentences.en: Yeah, you'd think so, right?
sentences.zh: 是啊，你肯定会这么想，对吧？

sentences.en: But Donald Trump can't let this go.
sentences.zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普无法放下这件事。

sentences.en: Jack Smith is the person who represents what Donald Trump thinks is this big, grand persecution against him.
sentences.zh: 杰克·史密斯代表了唐纳德·特朗普眼中那场针对他的巨大、宏大的迫害。

sentences.en: It's the whole rationale and the energy behind his re-election campaign and his drive for vengeance against his enemies.
sentences.zh: 这是他竞选连任以及向敌人复仇的全部逻辑和动力所在。

sentences.en: So Trump keeps picking at it, picking at it, going on True Social, accusing Jack Smith of being deranged.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普不断地纠缠这件事，在“真实社交”上发帖，指责杰克·史密斯精神失常。

sentences.en: This is one of the real burning issues for him.
sentences.zh: 这是他真正关心的核心问题之一。

sentences.en: And let me tell you, there are a lot of Republicans on Capitol Hill who never want to talk about this again and think that this is a big mistake
sentences.zh: 而且我告诉你，国会山有很多共和党人根本不想再谈论这件事，并认为这是一个巨大的错误，

sentences.en: as they head into the midterms, and frankly, think that it's a self-destructive impulse on the part of President Trump's.
sentences.zh: 在他们进入中期选举时，坦率地说，他们认为这是特朗普总统的一种自我毁灭冲动。

sentences.en: But he insisted on it, and ultimately, that is why Jack Smith testified in public today.
sentences.zh: 但他坚持要这样做，最终，这就是杰克·史密斯今天公开作证的原因。

sentences.en: And when you say Trump insisted on it, you mean Trump wanted Smith to be brought before Congress.
sentences.zh: 当你提到特朗普坚持要这样做时，你是说特朗普希望史密斯被带到国会面前。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Republicans, I think, would have been satisfied with Jack Smith testifying behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果杰克·史密斯在闭门会议中作证，共和党人本会感到满意。

sentences.en: But Donald Trump made a point of saying that he wanted Jack Smith, his enemy, to testify in public because Trump presumed that this would be a great opportunity to attack him.
sentences.zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普特意表示，他希望他的敌人杰克·史密斯公开作证，因为特朗普认为这将是一个攻击他的绝佳机会。

sentences.en: And perhaps Smith would make a mistake in the course of this testimony that would warrant what Trump wanted most of all, which is a criminal prosecution of Jack Smith.
sentences.zh: 也许史密斯在作证过程中会犯错，从而为特朗普最想要的结果——对杰克·史密斯进行刑事起诉——提供理由。

sentences.en: But as risky as this testimony, no doubt, must have seemed for Jack Smith as he prepared for it,
sentences.zh: 但尽管这次作证对杰克·史密斯来说无疑显得风险重重，

sentences.en: perhaps he also saw it as an opportunity to finally make the case that he and his team spent so much time building but were never given a chance to ever lay out.
sentences.zh: 也许他也将其视为一个机会，终于可以陈述他和他的团队花费了大量时间构建，却从未有机会展示的案件。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, what he really wanted to do was to stand in a courtroom and make this case to a jury.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，他真正想做的是站在法庭上向陪审团陈述这个案件。

sentences.en: This isn't quite the same thing, but it gave him an opportunity to make a lot of the points that he would have made in court.
sentences.zh: 这虽然不完全一样，但给了他一个机会，去陈述他在法庭上本会提出的许多观点。

sentences.en: Smith wasn't the only one incurring risk here.
sentences.zh: 史密斯并不是唯一一个承担风险的人。

sentences.en: House Republicans were very concerned about giving him a public forum to make the case against Trump because Smith is the best informed,
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人非常担心给他一个公开平台来陈述针对特朗普的案件，因为史密斯是特朗普所面临过的最了解情况、

sentences.en: the most disciplined, and most credible accuser Trump has really ever faced.
sentences.zh: 最自律、最可信的指控者。

sentences.en: So everybody involved kind of viewed this as a trial.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都把这看作是一场审判。

sentences.en: The Republicans wanted to make the case against Smith to impugn his motives, to sort of color some of these public disclosures in such a way
sentences.zh: 共和党人想针对史密斯进行辩护，质疑他的动机，以某种方式渲染这些公开披露的信息，

sentences.en: that it made Smith look like he was in cahoots with the Biden administration to destroy Trump, even though they didn't really have evidence to prove that.
sentences.zh: 使史密斯看起来像是与拜登政府勾结以摧毁特朗普，尽管他们并没有真正的证据来证明这一点。

sentences.en: But for Democrats, it was another opportunity to put Trump back on trial and actually to identify Republicans on the committee as kind of unindicted co-conspirators
sentences.zh: 但对于民主党人来说，这是另一个让特朗普重新受审的机会，实际上也是为了将委员会中的共和党人识别为某种未被起诉的同谋，

sentences.en: who enabled Donald Trump to get away with this and were now, in the view of Democrats, unconscionably defending him by attacking Jack Smith.
sentences.zh: 他们促成了唐纳德·特朗普逃脱惩罚，而在民主党人看来，他们现在正通过攻击杰克·史密斯来无理地为他辩护。

sentences.en: Well, Glenn, with all that in mind, take us into the actual hearing room on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 好吧，格伦，考虑到所有这些，带我们回到周四上午的听证会现场吧。

sentences.en: So you have this scene, which you've seen a million times on TV, packed committee room, lots of cameras around, people waiting for Smith to show up, and he kind of walks in.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到了那个场景，你在电视上见过无数次，挤满人的委员会会议室，周围有很多摄像机，人们等着史密斯出现，然后他走了进来。

sentences.en: And let me just point out, he strikes a different figure than most politicians or even prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 让我指出一点，他给人的印象与大多数政客甚至检察官都不同。

sentences.en: He is a triathlete.
sentences.zh: 他是一位铁人三项运动员。

sentences.en: He's dressed in this slim-cut blue suit.
sentences.zh: 他穿着这套修身的蓝色西装。

sentences.en: He has this almost Old Testament face with a salt-and-pepper beard.
sentences.zh: 他有着一张近乎旧约圣经中人物的面孔，留着灰白相间的胡须。

sentences.en: And his general vibe is kind of stony and unapproachable.
sentences.zh: 他给人的整体感觉是冷漠且难以接近的。

sentences.en: So he stands around awkwardly for a couple of minutes until he turns around and notices these four Capitol Police officers in the front row who were attacked on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 所以他尴尬地站了几分钟，直到他转过身，注意到前排那四名在1月6日遭到袭击的国会警察。

sentences.en: And suddenly he smiles, makes eye contact with them.
sentences.zh: 突然他笑了，与他们进行了眼神交流。

sentences.en: And that seemed to fortify him.
sentences.zh: 那似乎让他振作了起来。

sentences.en: Right, because it felt like those former Capitol Police officers were there to perhaps support him.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为感觉那些前国会警察可能是在那里支持他的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So he sits down at the witness table.
sentences.zh: 于是他在证人席坐下。

sentences.en: We welcome our witness today.
sentences.zh: 我们欢迎今天的证人。

sentences.en: We'll begin by swearing you in.
sentences.zh: 我们先为您宣誓。

sentences.en: Would you please rise and raise your right hand?
sentences.zh: 请您起立并举起右手好吗？

sentences.en: Then he gets sworn in.
sentences.zh: 然后他宣誓就职。

sentences.en: And a few minutes later, he begins to deliver his opening statement.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，他开始发表开场陈述。

sentences.en: Chairman Jordan, ranking member Raskin, members of the committee, thank you for the opportunity to discuss my work as special counsel.
sentences.zh: 乔丹主席，拉斯金资深议员，委员会成员们，感谢你们给我机会讨论我作为特别检察官的工作。

sentences.en: For nearly three decades, I've served as a career prosecutor in both Republican and Democratic administrations.
sentences.zh: 近三十年来，我一直在共和党和民主党政府中担任职业检察官。

sentences.en: He starts off by going through his resume.
sentences.zh: 他从介绍自己的履历开始。

sentences.en: I am not a politician, and I have no partisan loyalties.
sentences.zh: 我不是政客，我没有任何党派忠诚。

sentences.en: My career has been dedicated to serving our country by upholding the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 我的职业生涯致力于通过维护法治来服务我们的国家。

sentences.en: He emphasizes that everything he has ever done in his career has been apolitical and not motivated by any partisan animosity.
sentences.zh: 他强调他职业生涯中所做的一切都是非政治性的，不受任何党派敌意的影响。

sentences.en: As I testify before the committee today, I want to be clear.
sentences.zh: 今天在委员会作证时，我想明确一点。

sentences.en: I stand by my decisions as special counsel, including the decision to bring charges against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我坚持我作为特别检察官所做的决定，包括起诉特朗普总统的决定。

sentences.en: And then he gets to the heart of his argument.
sentences.zh: 然后他切入了论点的核心。

sentences.en: Our investigation developed proof beyond a reasonable doubt that President Trump engaged in criminal activity.
sentences.zh: 我们的调查得出了无可辩驳的证据，证明特朗普总统参与了犯罪活动。

sentences.en: One, that Donald Trump, according to the evidence that he collected, was guilty in both cases, definitively in his view.
sentences.zh: 第一，根据他收集的证据，唐纳德·特朗普在两起案件中都有罪，在他看来是确凿无疑的。

sentences.en: And then he makes the larger point about rule of law.
sentences.zh: 然后他提出了关于法治的更宏大的观点。

sentences.en: If asked whether to prosecute a former president based on the same facts today, I would do so regardless of whether that president was a Democrat or a Republican.
sentences.zh: 如果今天被问及是否要根据同样的事实起诉一位前总统，我依然会这样做，无论那位总统是民主党人还是共和党人。

sentences.en: No one, no one should be above the law in this country, and the law required that he be held to account.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，没有人，没有人应该凌驾于法律之上，法律要求他承担责任。

sentences.en: So that is what I did.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所做的。

sentences.en: To have done otherwise on the facts of these cases would have been to shirk my duties as a prosecutor and as a public servant, of which I had no intention of doing.
sentences.zh: 如果基于这些案件的事实而采取其他做法，那将是我作为检察官和公职人员的失职，而我绝无此意。

sentences.en: That holding Trump accountable, which obviously he was not able to do, was fundamental for ensuring that people in power
sentences.zh: 让特朗普承担责任，虽然他显然没能做到，但这对于确保掌权者

sentences.en: played by the same rules that all other Americans played by.
sentences.zh: 遵守与其他美国人相同的规则至关重要。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He seems to be doing a number of things here simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 他似乎在这里同时做了几件事。

sentences.en: He's very clearly saying the case that we built is sound and, in his mind, would have led to a conviction.
sentences.zh: 他非常清楚地表明，我们构建的案件是稳固的，在他看来，本会导致定罪。

sentences.en: And he's linking this case that never got to be, that never was, to this bigger question of whether in the Trump era, the rule of law is going to survive.
sentences.zh: 他将这个从未发生、从未存在的案件，与特朗普时代法治是否能存续这个更大的问题联系了起来。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百。

sentences.en: He's defending the evidence that he collected and his process for collecting that evidence, but he's also defending his decision to prosecute.
sentences.zh: 他不仅在捍卫他收集的证据以及收集证据的过程，也在捍卫他起诉的决定。

sentences.en: He's defending the principle upon which the Trump prosecutions were based, that no one is above the law and that letting Trump off the hook would embolden Trump to violate the law
sentences.zh: 他捍卫了特朗普起诉案所基于的原则，即没有人能凌驾于法律之上，如果让特朗普逃脱惩罚，会助长他违反法律的胆量，

sentences.en: if he ever regained power.
sentences.zh: 如果他再次掌权的话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then, after Smith is done, comes the questioning from members of this oversight committee.
sentences.zh: 然后，在史密斯陈述完毕后，来自这个监督委员会成员的质询开始了。

sentences.en: And I wonder, Glenn, if we can start with the Republicans who are, of course, running this entire thing.
sentences.zh: 格伦，我想我们可以先从那些正在运作这一切的共和党人开始谈起。

sentences.en: So, Michael, the predicate here is that the Republicans can't prove their one big point, which is that Jack Smith knowingly colluded with the Biden administration
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔，这里的前提是共和党人无法证明他们最大的观点，即杰克·史密斯明知故犯地与拜登政府勾结，

sentences.en: to destroy Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 以摧毁唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: They don't have any evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何证据证明这一点。

sentences.en: So, in the absence of that kind of information, they're going after smaller elements of Smith's investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，在缺乏此类信息的情况下，他们开始攻击史密斯调查中较小的部分。

sentences.en: And a good example of that is Lance Gooden.
sentences.zh: 兰斯·古登就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: The gentleman from Texas is recognized for five minutes.
sentences.zh: 现在请来自德克萨斯州的议员发言，时间五分钟。

sentences.en: This Republican from Texas asked about this document that Smith signed attesting that he was sworn in.
sentences.zh: 这位来自德克萨斯州的共和党人询问了史密斯签署的那份证明他已宣誓就职的文件。

sentences.en: You signed it on the 20th of November 2022, but there was no witness, which, I mean, you have to agree, it's a little odd.
sentences.zh: 您是在2022年11月20日签署的，但当时没有见证人，我的意思是，您得承认，这有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Months later, Smith had another swearing in.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，史密斯又进行了一次宣誓就职。

sentences.en: So, Gooden asked Smith why he was sworn in twice.
sentences.zh: 所以，古登问史密斯为什么要宣誓两次。

sentences.en: So, why did you take the oath of office again on the 14th of September of the following year when you say you took the office in November of 2022?
sentences.zh: 那么，既然您说您是在2022年11月就职的，为什么您要在次年的9月14日再次进行就职宣誓呢？

sentences.en: Why'd you need to do it twice?
sentences.zh: 您为什么需要做两次？

sentences.en: My recollection is that I took the oath of office, as you said, it was the 18th of the 20th, and felt I was under the oath of office.
sentences.zh: 我的记忆是，我确实进行了就职宣誓，正如您所说，是在18日或20日，我当时觉得我已经在宣誓就职了。

sentences.en: I believe, if you have it in front of you, I think I signed an oath.
sentences.zh: 我相信，如果您手头有那份文件的话，我想我确实签署了一份誓词。

sentences.en: You signed it, but there was no witness.
sentences.zh: 您签署了，但没有见证人。

sentences.en: There was supposed to be either notarized or a witness,
sentences.zh: 按理说要么需要公证，要么需要见证人，

sentences.en: and apparently Attorney General Garland thought it was significant enough to have you do another oath 11 months later.
sentences.zh: 显然司法部长加兰认为这很重要，以至于在11个月后又让您重新宣誓了一次。

sentences.en: That's strange, right?
sentences.zh: 这很奇怪，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know why they asked me to sign it again.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们为什么要求我重新签署。

sentences.en: I don't recall ever discussing this issue with Attorney General Garland.
sentences.zh: 我不记得曾与加兰司法部长讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: Well, that is just wild to me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这在我看来简直太离谱了。

sentences.en: So they weren't only trying to undermine the legitimacy of his actions, but they were actually attempting to undermine the legal legitimacy of his appointment.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不仅试图削弱他行动的合法性，实际上还在试图削弱他任命的法律合法性。

sentences.en: How much money did you spend in investigating President Trump?
sentences.zh: 您在调查特朗普总统身上花了多少钱？

sentences.en: Another line of questioning revolved around a recent revelation that the FBI paid informants to examine some of the people in the crowd on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 另一条质询路线围绕着最近披露的一件事，即联邦调查局曾向线人付费，以调查1月6日人群中的一些人。

sentences.en: We know you gave $20,000 to someone.
sentences.zh: 我们知道您给了某人2万美元。

sentences.en: It just got reported last week.
sentences.zh: 这还是上周才报道出来的。

sentences.en: How much more money did you pay confidential people, people we don't know about, with American tax money going after the guy we elected president?
sentences.zh: 您还向那些我们不知道的机密人员支付了多少钱？用美国纳税人的钱去对付我们选出的总统？

sentences.en: With the suggestion, of course, that Smith had to pay off people to collect dirt on his investigative targets.
sentences.zh: 当然，这暗示了史密斯必须花钱收买他人，以搜集他调查对象的黑料。

sentences.en: My recollection regards the $20,000, which was not a payment from me.
sentences.zh: 关于那2万美元，我的记忆是，那不是我支付的款项。

sentences.en: It was me approving a payment by the FBI to a confidential human source who was reviewing video and photographic accounts.
sentences.zh: 那是我批准联邦调查局向一位正在审查视频和照片记录的机密人类来源支付的费用。

sentences.en: Who's the source?
sentences.zh: 这个来源是谁？

sentences.en: I do not know the identity of the source.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该来源的身份。

sentences.en: How many other payments went to this source or other sources?
sentences.zh: 还有多少笔款项支付给了这个来源或其他来源？

sentences.en: The most substantial issue the Republicans raised and the one they spent the most time on at the hearing was this matter of the toll records,
sentences.zh: 共和党人在听证会上提出的最实质性问题，也是他们花费时间最多的问题，就是关于通话记录的事，

sentences.en: the metadata that Jack Smith and his team obtained on phone conversations between Trump, Trump's team, Rudy Giuliani, and nine lawmakers on Capitol Hill that Trump was pressuring
sentences.zh: 也就是杰克·史密斯及其团队获取的关于特朗普、特朗普团队、鲁迪·朱利安尼以及国会山九名议员之间通话的元数据，而特朗普当时正在向这些议员施压，

sentences.en: to overturn the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 要求推翻2020年大选结果。

sentences.en: And Glenn, what makes Smith's efforts to get that data so controversial for these Republicans?
sentences.zh: 格伦，史密斯获取这些数据的努力为何让这些共和党人如此反感？

sentences.en: And perhaps here you do need to do just a little bit of explaining about what exactly Smith did how he did it.
sentences.zh: 也许在这里您确实需要稍微解释一下史密斯到底做了什么，以及他是怎么做的。

sentences.en: So toll records are not wiretaps of phone calls.
sentences.zh: 通话记录并不是电话窃听。

sentences.en: As some Republicans have claimed.
sentences.zh: 正如一些共和党人所声称的那样。

sentences.en: What they are, are just simple records of calls.
sentences.zh: 它们只是简单的通话记录。

sentences.en: The duration, the two phone numbers involved, the time that they took place.
sentences.zh: 包括通话时长、涉及的两个电话号码以及通话发生的时间。

sentences.en: Smith's team wanted this information so that they could establish a timeline of efforts to pressure lawmakers into overturning the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 史密斯团队想要这些信息，是为了建立一个时间线，梳理出向议员施压以推翻2020年大选的种种努力。

sentences.en: But they also did something else.
sentences.zh: 但他们还做了另一件事。

sentences.en: Smith's team asked a federal judge in Washington not to disclose to the targets that he was obtaining this information.
sentences.zh: 史密斯团队要求华盛顿的一名联邦法官不要向调查对象透露他正在获取这些信息。

sentences.en: Now, there are a bunch of investigative reasons for doing that, according to former prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 据前检察官称，这样做有很多调查上的理由。

sentences.en: But Republicans seized on this to make the point that Smith's team were doing something shady, underhanded, and that they had already concluded
sentences.zh: 但共和党人抓住这一点，以此证明史密斯团队在做一些阴暗、卑鄙的事情，而且他们早就已经断定

sentences.en: that they were going after President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们要对付特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Mr. Smith, in January of 2023, did you subpoena then Speaker of the House
sentences.zh: 史密斯先生，在2023年1月，您是否传唤了时任众议院议长

sentences.en: Kevin McCarthy's toll records?
sentences.zh: 凯文·麦卡锡的通话记录？

sentences.en: Uh, yes, sir, we did.
sentences.zh: 呃，是的，先生，我们传唤了。

sentences.en: Two Republicans from Texas really drove this point home.
sentences.zh: 两位来自德克萨斯州的共和党人确实有力地强调了这一点。

sentences.en: One of them, Brandon Gill, really put Smith on the hot seat.
sentences.zh: 其中一位，布兰登·吉尔，真的让史密斯处于了风口浪尖。

sentences.en: How many days after Kevin McCarthy was sworn in as Speaker, did you subpoena his records?
sentences.zh: 在凯文·麦卡锡宣誓就任议长后多少天，您传唤了他的记录？

sentences.en: Uh, I don't recall, but those two things had nothing to do with one.
sentences.zh: 呃，我不记得了，但这两件事之间没有任何联系。

sentences.en: It was 16 days after becoming the highest-ranking Republican in the House of Representatives, you subpoenaed his toll records.
sentences.zh: 是在他成为众议院最高级别共和党人16天后，您就传唤了他的通话记录。

sentences.en: But an even more extraordinary moment came when Chip Roy, his colleague, asked Smith why Smith's team had obtained his own phone records.
sentences.zh: 但更令人震惊的时刻是，他的同事奇普·罗伊问史密斯，为什么史密斯团队获取了他自己的电话记录。

sentences.en: Did you target my records and subpoena my phone toll records?
sentences.zh: 您是否针对我的记录并传唤了我的电话通话记录？

sentences.en: Uh, my understanding is your records were subpoenaed by prosecutors before I became special counsel.
sentences.zh: 呃，据我了解，您的记录是在我担任特别检察官之前被检察官传唤的。

sentences.en: I'm thankful for the great staff who discovered the email where I learned for the first time a few weeks ago that my phone records were indeed targeted.
sentences.zh: 我很感谢那些出色的工作人员，他们发现了那封电子邮件，我几周前才第一次得知我的电话记录确实被针对了。

sentences.en: We called AT&T, and we've learned that they were given to the Department of Justice, as this email indicates.
sentences.zh: 我们给AT&T打了电话，得知正如这封邮件所示，这些记录被交给了司法部。

sentences.en: This happened four years ago in May of 2022, and I couldn't object because I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 这发生在四年前的2022年5月，我当时无法提出异议，因为我根本不知道。

sentences.en: I didn't know until about three weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 直到大约三周前我才知道。

sentences.en: Basically, they're asking, did Smith and his staff spy on Republican members of Congress?
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们是在问，史密斯和他的工作人员是否在监视共和党国会议员？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This really felt like the one moment where Republicans really had Smith on the defensive.
sentences.zh: 这确实感觉是共和党人真正让史密斯处于守势的时刻。

sentences.en: You also sought orders from judges, making it so those who were having their records seized would not know about it.
sentences.zh: 您还向法官寻求命令，使得那些记录被扣押的人不会知道这件事。

sentences.en: And you even didn't tell those judges that it was members of Congress whose records you were going after.
sentences.zh: 而且您甚至没有告诉那些法官，您要获取的是国会议员的记录。

sentences.en: If you sought to do that today, would you be able to get away with that?
sentences.zh: 如果您今天想这样做，您还能得逞吗？

sentences.en: When we secured these toll records subpoenas, it was done consistent with department policy.
sentences.zh: 当我们获得这些通话记录传票时，这是符合部门政策的。

sentences.en: You're correct in that that policy has since changed.
sentences.zh: 您说得对，该政策此后已经改变了。

sentences.en: They changed the policy based upon the actions that you took.
sentences.zh: 他们根据您的所作所为修改了政策。

sentences.en: Glenn, as best you can tell, did this Republican strategy work?
sentences.zh: 格伦，据您所知，共和党的这一策略奏效了吗？

sentences.en: I'll tell you this.
sentences.zh: 我告诉您吧。

sentences.en: Smith's discipline, and that's kind of the hallmark of his management style, really paid off for him.
sentences.zh: 史密斯的纪律性，这也是他管理风格的标志，确实为他带来了回报。

sentences.en: There was this moment where Kevin Kiley, a Republican from California, asks Smith,
sentences.zh: 当时加利福尼亚州的共和党人凯文·凯利问史密斯：

sentences.en: Do you believe that you made any mistakes?
sentences.zh: 您认为您犯过任何错误吗？

sentences.en: Do you have any regrets as to how you conducted this investigation?
sentences.zh: 对于您进行这项调查的方式，您有什么遗憾吗？

sentences.en: Can you tell me any kind of mistake that you made?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我您犯过的任何错误吗？

sentences.en: Is there anything that you regret?
sentences.zh: 有什么事情是您后悔的吗？

sentences.en: If I have any regret, it would be not expressing enough appreciation for my staff who work so hard in these investigations.
sentences.zh: 如果说我有什么遗憾的话，那就是没有对在这些调查中辛勤工作的员工表达足够的赞赏。

sentences.en: Smith wasn't going for that.
sentences.zh: 史密斯可不吃这一套。

sentences.en: All he responded with was that he hadn't thanked his staff sufficiently.
sentences.zh: 他回应的仅仅是他没有充分感谢他的员工。

sentences.en: He seemed determined not to give Republicans an inch.
sentences.zh: 他似乎下定决心不给共和党人留任何余地。

sentences.en: But when Democrats questioned him, he was a good deal more expansive.
sentences.zh: 但当民主党人质询他时，他表现得要从容得多。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Glenn, talk us through how the Democrats approach Smith with their questions.
sentences.zh: 格伦，请给我们讲讲民主党人是如何用他们的问题来对待史密斯的。

sentences.en: The Democrats basically wanted to paint Smith as a hero.
sentences.zh: 民主党人基本上想把史密斯塑造成一个英雄。

sentences.en: I want to thank you for your service.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢您的服务。

sentences.en: I think you're a great American.
sentences.zh: 我认为您是一位伟大的美国人。

sentences.en: As somebody who risked Donald Trump's ire.
sentences.zh: 作为冒着唐纳德·特朗普愤怒风险的人。

sentences.en: Your willingness to speak directly to us and to the American people about your investigation is professional, is courageous, and it's patriotic.
sentences.zh: 您愿意直接向我们和美国人民谈论您的调查，这是专业的、勇敢的，也是爱国的。

sentences.en: Somebody who was willing to stand up to Donald Trump and hold him accountable.
sentences.zh: 一个愿意站出来对抗唐纳德·特朗普并让他承担责任的人。

sentences.en: Please know that I and my colleagues on the Democratic side and even my Republican colleagues when they speak privately have nothing but respect and appreciation
sentences.zh: 请知道，我和民主党同事，甚至我的共和党同事在私下交谈时，对您所做的一切以及您的做法，只有尊重和赞赏。

sentences.en: for what you tried to do and how you did it.
sentences.zh: 您与这里的许多人不同，您是一个有荣誉感的人。

sentences.en: You, unlike many here, are a man of honor.
sentences.zh: 他们也急于保护他，并消除人们对他活动的任何疑虑。

sentences.en: And they were also eager to protect him and to clean up any doubts people might have about his activities.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈通话记录，因为这个问题已经被提出来了，

sentences.en: Let's go to the toll records since that's been raised,
sentences.zh: 史密斯先生。

sentences.en: Mr. Smith.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他们直接深入探讨了共和党人提出的通话记录问题。

sentences.en: And that was why they dove right into this question of the toll records that the Republicans brought up.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是那些电话记录。

sentences.en: Right, those phone records.
sentences.zh: 委员会中最高级别的民主党人杰米·拉斯金插话，给史密斯一个解释自己的机会。

sentences.en: Jamie Raskin, who is the top Democrat on the committee, jumped in to give Smith the chance to explain himself.
sentences.zh: 您所做的一切是完全合法的。

sentences.en: It was perfectly lawful what you did.
sentences.zh: 解释一下您为什么要那些通话记录。

sentences.en: Explain why did you want those toll records.
sentences.zh: 我们正在调查的阴谋，获取通话记录对于了解该阴谋的范围、他们试图胁迫谁、他们试图

sentences.en: The conspiracy that we were investigating, it was relevant to get toll records to understand the scope of that conspiracy, who they were seeking to coerce, who they were seeking
